record.original_question: Let f be a real-analytic symplectic diffeomorphism of R^{2n} fixing the origin, with linear part conjugate to a product of planar rotations and with Diophantine rotation vector α. Does there exist ε0>0 such that the ball ||z||≤ε0 contains a subset of positive Lebesgue measure consisting of invariant Lagrangian tori of f?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:\mathbb{R}^{2n}\to\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ be a real-analytic symplectic diffeomorphism (with respect to the standard symplectic form) fixing the origin. Assume that its linearization $Df(0)\in\mathrm{Sp}(2n,\mathbb{R})$ is conjugate to the direct product of planar rotations by angles $2\pi\alpha_1,\dots,2\pi\alpha_n$, and that the frequency vector $\alpha=(\alpha_1,\dots,\alpha_n)\in\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfies a Diophantine condition: there exist $\gamma>0$ and $\tau>0$ such that for every $k\in\mathbb{Z}^n\setminus\{0\}$ and every $\ell\in\mathbb{Z}$,
$$|\langle k,\alpha\rangle-\ell|\geq \gamma\,|k|^{-\tau}.$$
An invariant Lagrangian torus of $f$ is an embedded $n$-dimensional torus $T\subset\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ that is Lagrangian for the standard symplectic form and satisfies $f(T)=T$.

Prove or disprove: there exists $\varepsilon_0>0$ such that the closed ball $\{z\in\mathbb{R}^{2n}:\|z\|\leq\varepsilon_0\}$ contains a subset of positive Lebesgue measure consisting of invariant Lagrangian tori of $f$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is Herman's conjecture (posed at the 1998 ICM) on accumulation of an elliptic fixed point by KAM tori of positive measure. It is established for $n=2$ degrees of freedom and, in higher dimensions, under a Rüssmann transversality condition on the Birkhoff normal form (Eliasson–Fayad–Krikorian); Eliasson–Fayad–Krikorian also showed accumulation by complex-analytic KAM tori in general. The full conjecture without nondegeneracy assumptions remains open.

status_evidence.title: Around the stability of KAM tori — Eliasson, Fayad, Krikorian
status_evidence.snippet: If the Birkhoff normal form satisfies a Rüssmann transversality condition, the fixed point is accumulated by real analytic KAM tori of positive Lebesgue measure.
status_evidence.claim: Partial resolution under a Rüssmann transversality condition on the Birkhoff normal form.
